title: A Course on Measure Theory
description: Foundations of measure, σ-algebras, outer measures, Lebesgue integration, and the convergence theorems.

sections.title: Prerequisites & Foundations
sections.description: Topology of ℝⁿ, metric spaces, limits of sets, and preliminary real analysis.

sections.title: σ-Algebras & Outer Measures
sections.description: Algebras, σ-algebras, Borel sets, outer measures, and Carathéodory's extension theorem.

sections.title: Measures & Lebesgue Measure
sections.description: Measure spaces, construction and regularity of Lebesgue measure, null sets, and Vitali sets.

sections.title: Lebesgue Integration & Convergence Theorems
sections.description: Measurable functions, the Lebesgue integral, MCT, Fatou's Lemma, DCT, Egorov, Lusin, and Fubini–Tonelli.
